hook_text: Six postcards from one road trip. Each one shows a different South Africa.
clip_script: Kroonstad. Six postcards pinned around a map. The Highveld: high grassland and maize. The Lowveld: hot bushveld with giraffes in the Kruger Park. The Great Karoo: dry plains and windmills. The Little Karoo: a valley of ostriches. The Kalahari: red sand dunes and camel thorn trees. And Namaqualand: a carpet of flowers after winter rain. One country, six very different regions.
visual_style: Whiteboard map of South Africa with six postcards drawing themselves and strings linking each to its region.
mood: Bright and travelling, like flipping through holiday postcards.
pacing: One postcard per beat, quick and colourful.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find which region your own town is in.
